recommendedEntrypoints.name: local-wrapper
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: This repository includes the Koala bootstrap wrapper.

recommendedEntrypoints.name: global-fallback
recommendedEntrypoints.useWhen: Only the global koala CLI is available; include read-only recording for session_brief heartbeats.

notes: This file is read by Koala tooling, not by the Codex runtime.
Codex agent prompts live in .Codex/agents and are generated from .claude/agents.
Claude Code hooks, settings, and skills remain under .claude only.
Run node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex after changing Codex adapter assets; it records codex_adapter_verification evidence for gates.
